title: ResourceRef
description: A portable reference to a shared resource (table, bucket, queue, vector index, graph store, sandbox volume, temp dataset, object store). Business logic NEVER names a raw table/bucket/path or embeds a raw key — it carries a ResourceRef whose logical_name + kind_code + ownership_code resolve to a physical resource via a ResourceBinding. kind_code/ownership_code -> architecture/shared_resource_spine.json.

binding_ref.description: id of the ResourceBinding that resolves the physical resource
